text:
marta (Product): @here Quick launch callout — Hosted Async Embeddings (batch) v1 is GA :tada:

marta (Product): What this includes: async batch endpoint for high-throughput embed jobs, resumable jobs, job metadata + per-job cost estimates, and a new bulk-uploads flow for files. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/embeddings-async

marta (Product): Important operational notes:
- We're replacing the old /v1/embeddings/bulk-old path with /v1/embeddings:async (see migration below).
- New per-customer embedding-queue quotas (default 2 concurrent jobs, burst up to 5 while in canary).
- Dedicated customers: scheduled rollout next week, contact PL for manual opt-in.

marta (Product): Quick example (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings:async -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input_files": ["s3://my-bucket/large-corpus.jsonl"], "model":"embed-large-2026","priority":"standard"}'
```

alex (Eng Runtime): Congrats! A couple Qs: do we need a new kernel path in runtime for large-batch KV caching?

alex (Eng Runtime): Also, will the async endpoint honor per-token batching optimizations or is it whole-job serialized?

marta (Product): alex — good Qs. Runtime should use the same KV-cache optimizations when jobs are chunked by prefix. For extremely large single-file jobs we shard input and run parallel chunks; runtime has a new job-sharder flag.

alex (Eng Runtime): Nice. I'll add the job-sharder flag to the runtime config and include telemetry for shard success/fail rates.

jo (DevEx): I will add a quickstart sample and update the Python/TS SDKs to expose start_job + poll_job helpers. ETA EOD tomorrow for Python sample.

sanjay (Infra): Heads up — quota changes mean we need to update the quota-service and the per-customer dashboard. I'll queue a migration job for midnight Wed. Any objections to a rolling window for the quota enforcement (instead of a hard cap) to smooth burst traffic?

marta (Product): rolling window sounds right; keeps latency-friendly bursts. Sanjay, please coordinate with Alex on telemetry so we can alert on long queue backlogs.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started: embeddings-async-v1 -> canary pool (count: 20 nodes) at 2026-05-14T02:24:01Z. Monitor: https://ops.redwood.ai/canaries/embeddings-async-v1

jo (DevEx): Noted — will add canary notes to quickstart and a troubleshooting FAQ for timeouts and partial failures.

marta (Product): Migration plan summary:
1) Today: GA announcement + docs + SDK PRs.
2) +48hrs: Canary metrics review, iterate on job-sharder defaults.
3) +7 days: Gradual deprecation notice for /v1/embeddings/bulk-old (read-only mode).
4) +30 days: Hard deprecation of old endpoint (customers will get a 14d notice before final cutoff).

marta (Product): Support playbook and escalation steps: https://go.redwood.ai/playbooks/embeddings-async (please read if you're on support/ops).

alex (Eng Runtime): I'll add shard failure telemetry and a fallback to smaller shard sizes if we hit OOM patterns.

sanjay (Infra): I'll patch quotas to use a sliding-window limiter, and add a Grafana dashboard for job queue length + per-customer wait times.

marta (Product): Thanks all. Callouts for the rest of the org: update product changelog, marketing will send external GA announcement tomorrow, and account teams will get a tailored migration guide. If you see any urgent issues ping me directly. :rocket:
